svg.aria-label: Card stack: Swipe right: read · left: save · up: open · down: skip. Summary on the card: Long-press a card for 3 key points from the on-device AI. Auto-advance: Skips each card after a few seconds, with a wavy countdown ring. Next group: When a group is done, the next one follows; a bar shows the whole run. Jump between groups: Tap the group name under “Triage” to pick another. Share: Tap Share for the link; hold it to share the card as a picture. Inbox zero: A little celebration when you’re all caught up.
